...

This world was good only we were alive.

Hey!
You!

嘿！
你！

你是第一个让我脑袋里喷出草莓酱的人。

Trick..
scripts.translation:

特里克...

谢谢。

如果不介意的话，能再帮个忙吗？
南瓜蛋糕还缺很多。

......

[Chef Candycon]

scripts.translation:
[厨师 糖果康]
什么？你们日落后就能到处走。而且你们有翅膀和夜视能力...还有？超声波...？！！

[Treat]

scripts.translation:
[糖果]

scripts.text:
[Trick]

^ff9000Will you proceed?^000000

Cool! Pumpkin has been carved just in shape? This is it for Halloween! Halloween without Jack'o lantern can't be real Halloween!

[厨师 糖果康]
酷！南瓜雕刻得形状很完美？这就是万圣节的样子！没有杰克灯就不是真正的万圣节！

scripts.text:
[Chef Candycon]
Take this, it's a reward for bringing pumpkins! Open it, there might be some fun stuff...
scripts.translation:
[厨师 糖果康]
拿着，这是你带来南瓜的奖励！打开看看，里面可能有一些有趣的东西...

scripts.text:
[Trick]
It's really fresh, outside of coffin?
Have you got 30 pumpkins?
scripts.translation:
[特里克]
棺材外面真的很新鲜啊？
你拿到30个南瓜了吗？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[特里克]
如果你把它们都带回来了，就交给那边的厨师。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Trick]
Gosh....
scripts.translation:
[特里克]
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Trick]

As I will just mess up everything! Wahahahaa!
scripts.translation:
[特里克]
我不需要甜食！！
因为我只会把一切都搞砸！哇哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[糖果]

scripts.text:

-giggle-
scripts.translation:
[糖果]

哇...这些种子味道真浓郁。
不管多少，我都能吃得下。

scripts.translation:
[小鸡]
嘿，肯塔基！！
你一个人吃太多了！

scripts.text:

-giggle-
The festival is about to begin...

[游荡的灵魂]
-咯咯-

scripts.translation:
[游荡的灵魂]
活人不能参加尼弗海姆的节日。-咯咯-

scripts.text:
[Wandering soul]

Doesn't it seem like something is wrong??
scripts.translation:
[游荡的灵魂]
节日给“死者之城”带来了生机....
这难道不觉得哪里不对劲吗？
